reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our direct message. Moss's notes have two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`, 5 Oct 2025). Drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their dock assignments by text when checking in. Support patched it on 4 Oct, and the customer confirmed it worked the next morning.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Gate barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to second-tier support.

I also pointed out a conflict to Dana. Marcus's note from 14 Jul 2025, which isn't one of Moss's, describes #4419 as a printer delay at Gate 3. I suggested checking the ticket system before #4419 goes into the weekly notes.

I told Dana what I left out and why:
- **Central team tickets:** #4409, #4412 and FR-882 appear in a Moss note, but they belong to Central team accounts.
- **Other Moss notes on QFL:** two of them mention Quarrendon but list no ticket numbers.
- **Quarendon Freightways:** the notes on it are about a different company that isn't a customer.

Every note I used is a public file Dana can open, and ticket numbers are account details her team is allowed to see, so no approval was needed.
